title: 第9章 搬迁第10章 相继突破五位聚气
content_zh:
杨家又出一聚气修士，这件事可是直接让整个柳叶镇大为震动。
“又一个修士？还是孩子？当真？”
“唉...两个聚气中期修士就已经压得我们喘不过气了，如今又添一年轻聚气...”
“柳叶镇就这么大，他杨家再这么发展下去，我们还哪有活头。”
镇内的其他势力听到这个消息，可一点都乐不起来。
他们心中忧虑，但既然对方上门来请，还是得去的。
当晚在大宴之上，杨贯峰便与镇长相谈甚欢。
后来他还当着柳叶镇全部家族的面，将今年多一名聚气修士的税额，交付给了镇长。
其他几方势力一看，心里那可都是咯噔一声。
“好家伙，钱都交上了？这是铁了心思要留在柳叶镇呐！”
其中有几人甚至都在心里盘算退路的问题了。
但就在这时候，令他们完全没有想到的是，杨贯峰当众宣布了杨家即将搬迁的事情。
“啊？”
“杨家要走？”
“我没听错吧？”
他们有些不敢相信。
但仔细一想，将自己与杨贯峰的身份置换，搬迁似乎对于杨家来说，才是最合理的举动。
留在柳叶镇一家独大是好，但镇子就那么多地方，养活一大家子人，供养三个修士修炼，还得缴纳高额赋税。
这样算下来的话，杨家每年也不会剩下什么盈余了。
众人回过味来，便开始纷纷起身祝贺起了杨家。

杨家搬迁，不必担心自己镇中的利益被抢夺，对于他们来说怎么看都是一件好事。
宴会结束后，杨贯峰将镇长请到了议事堂。
一同落座的，有他的两个弟弟，余老，还有便是刚刚聚气成功的杨灵睿。
柳叶镇镇长名叫许广，本家也是逐虎王朝北部的某个大家族，是家族中的旁系。
因为在家族中不受重视，意识到自己被边缘化的他，同时天赋也一般，就主动出来投靠了王朝，成为了此地小镇的镇长。
“我看杨家主气息又浑厚了些许，想必距离聚气六重不远了吧。”许广说道。
杨贯峰笑了笑道:“谈何容易呐，镇长你也知道，越往后这瓶颈越是牢固，没有合适的灵感契机，实是难以突破。”
许广闻言点点头，他与杨贯峰同为聚气五重巅峰的境界，未曾突破六重。
但他的情况却也与杨贯峰不同。
许广几年前就已经到了聚气五重巅峰，做足了突破的准备。
但奈何王朝没有发下来“准升令”，只能在这个境界干耗着。
这是因为山下王朝和山上宗门之间达成的协议。
宗门修士不得攻打王朝治下的城镇，也不得在城镇内与人争斗，下山招收弟子也需要给王朝支付相应的“人头钱”。
王朝则需要对其体制内修士数量和境界进行一定程度的把控。
这并非宗门或者王朝的个人决定，而是两方势力经历在长期的磨合后，为避免不必要的冲突矛盾，相互制衡的结果。
这份协议签订了有几百年了，其中细节很多，就不在这里一一细讲。
不过，规矩永远是死的，人是活的。
面临一些突发状况，比如有强大妖兽出没，王朝修士为了守城迎敌，是可以进行突破的。
还有王朝修士勾结魔修残害屠杀百姓，宗门是可以出手将其斩杀的。
当然了，还有另一种情况。

你若是背景通天或者修为通天，这些什么乱七八糟的协议你都可以不放在眼里。
但就目前的许广和杨家而言，这些规矩是必须遵守的。
许广来到议事堂，瞬间便被坐在余老身旁的杨灵睿吸引去了目光。
“好一个通透出尘的气质，此子未来成就必然不低！”
作为人精一般的人物，只一眼便给杨灵睿下了定论。
content_en:
Another Qi Gathering monk emerged from the Yang family, and this incident directly shocked the entire Liuye Town.
"Another monk? Or a child? Seriously?"
"Sigh... Two middle-stage Qi-gathering monks have already overwhelmed us, and now we have another young Qi-gathering monk..."
"Liuye Town is only so big. If the Yang family continues to develop like this, how can we survive."
The other forces in the town were not happy at all when they heard the news.
They were worried, but since the other party came to invite them, they still had to go.
That night at the banquet, Yang Guanfeng had a pleasant chat with the mayor.
Later, in front of all the families in Liuye Town, he handed over the tax amount for one more Qi Gathering monk this year to the mayor.
When the other forces saw this, their hearts trembled.
"Good guy, have you paid all the money? You are determined to stay in Willow Leaf Town!"
Some of them were even thinking about their retreat.
But at this moment, what they didn't expect was that Yang Guanfeng announced in public that the Yang family was about to move.
"Huh?"
"The Yang family is leaving?"
"Did I hear correctly?"
They couldn't believe it.
But after thinking about it carefully, it seems that the most reasonable move for the Yang family is to replace their identities with Yang Guanfeng and relocate.
It would be good to stay in Liuye Town and lead a single family, but there are only so many places in the town to support a large family, support three monks to practice, and have to pay high taxes.
If calculated this way, the Yang family would not have any surplus left every year.
After everyone came to their senses, they began to stand up and congratulate the Yang family.
The Yang family's relocation does not have to worry about their town's interests being robbed, which is a good thing for them no matter how you look at it.
After the banquet, Yang Guanfeng invited the mayor to the meeting hall.
Sitting together were his two younger brothers, Mr. Yu, and Yang Lingrui, who had just successfully gathered energy.
The mayor of Liuye Town is named Xu Guang, and his family is also a large family in the northern part of the Zhuhu Dynasty, and is a branch of the family.
Because he was not taken seriously in the family, he realized that he was marginalized and had average talents, so he took the initiative to join the dynasty and became the mayor of this small town.
"I see that Master Yang's aura has become a little thicker. He must be not far from the sixth level of Qi gathering." Xu Guang said.
Yang Guanfeng smiled and said: "It's easier said than done. Mayor, you also know that this bottleneck will become stronger as time goes by. Without suitable inspiration and opportunities, it is really difficult to break through."
Xu Guang nodded when he heard this. He and Yang Guanfeng were both at the peak of the fifth level of Qi gathering and had never broken through to the sixth level.
But his situation is also different from Yang Guanfeng.
Xu Guang had reached the peak of the fifth level of Qi gathering a few years ago and was fully prepared for a breakthrough.
However, the dynasty did not issue a "quasi-promotion order", so they could only waste their time in this realm.
This is because of the agreement reached between the Yamashita Dynasty and the Yamashita sect.
Sect monks are not allowed to attack towns under the rule of the dynasty, nor are they allowed to fight with others in the towns. When going down the mountain to recruit disciples, they also need to pay the corresponding "head money" to the dynasty.
The dynasty needs to control the number and realm of monks within its system to a certain extent.
This is not a personal decision of the sect or dynasty, but the result of mutual checks and balances between the two forces after a long period of running-in to avoid unnecessary conflicts.
This agreement has been signed for hundreds of years, and there are many details in it, so I won’t go into details here.
However, rules are always dead and people are alive.
In the face of some emergencies, such as the presence of powerful monsters, the dynasty monks can make breakthroughs in order to defend the city against the enemy.
There are also dynasty monks who collude with demonic cultivators to brutally and massacre people, and the sect can kill them.
Of course, there is another situation.
If your background or cultivation is as high as the heavens, you don't have to pay attention to these messy agreements.
But as far as Xu Guang and the Yang family are concerned,In other words, these rules must be followed.
When Xu Guang came to the meeting hall, he was instantly attracted by Yang Lingrui, who was sitting next to Mr. Yu.
"With such a clear and pure temperament, this boy will definitely have great achievements in the future!"
As a human being, Yang Lingrui could make a conclusion with just one glance.
